headline: No API changes break the bot today; the ideas add a one-tap mood check to the morning brief, size each trade from your stop instead of your leverage, and label newly listed coins in the scanner.

ideas.title: One-tap mood check in the 08:00 brief
ideas.why: A study of 80 day traders found those with the strongest emotional swings after wins and losses traded significantly worse. Add 4 buttons to the brief (calm / OK / tense / tired) and later show your PnL and rule breaks by mood, so you learn which mornings to trade small or skip.

ideas.title: /size: position size from your stop, not your leverage
ideas.why: Type /size 1.25 1.23 (entry, stop) and the bot works out the position that loses a fixed amount, e.g. 1 USDT, at the stop, then the margin at 10/20/40×. Leverage then only changes margin, not what you can lose, and the bot warns if liquidation sits before your stop.

ideas.title: "New" label for recently listed coins
ideas.why: Coins listed less than about 33 days ago don't have enough 4h candles for EMA 200, so the scanner quietly scores them lower with no reason shown. Label them "New" so you know why, and treat them as extra risky: half of Binance perp listings peaked on day one.

watch: Binance lowers max leverage on 15 USDⓈ-M perps on 30 Oct at 06:30 UTC (09:30 Addis): APR, AIO, TRIA, WET and STBL go from 50× to 25×, and 10 more (incl. GOAT, TURTLE, Q) lose their top tier. Open positions are affected, so check before holding any of these through 09:30.

sources.title: Fear and Greed in Financial Markets: A Clinical Study of Day-Traders (Lo, Repin & Steenbarger)
